q1_issues.issue: "The PracticeWorks acquisition" is a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head, which mandates the opaque `Possession` link; `(Of sk_acquisition_1 practiceworks)` uses a preposition-named oblique with no preposition in the text.

`(Possession sk_revenue_1 kodak)` sits at top level although "Kodak's revenue" is mentioned only inside the sealed complement — the projection table lets only Member/Name typing out of an attitude seal and keeps possessor links sealed.
The Measure inside the seal uses the scale `quantity`, which no word in the sentence supplies; the reserved filler for an unstated dimension is `unspecified`.
The direct object of "add" (about $215 million) gets no role atom — the amount survives only as an event-level Measure.

q2_gaps: a measure phrase as a verb's direct object ("add $215 million to X") — `Measure` attaches to entities and `MeasureBy`/`MeasureTo` to scalar-change eventualities, leaving no slot for the amount as an object
notes: Routing "is expected to …" as an impersonal reported attitude — attitude event with no Experiencer, complement sealed under Theme, subject typing projected — is correct, and all three coordinated complements are present with the right reification/dual-emit and the 10% sigma on "about $215 million". The three defects are localized rather than structural.
